name: How much does deck resurfacing cost?
description: Deck resurfacing costs depend on deck size, condition, materials, and repair extent. A professional on-site evaluation provides an accurate estimate.

mainEntity.name: How much does deck resurfacing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of deck resurfacing varies based on the deck's size, condition, the materials chosen for repair and finishing, and the extent of preparation needed. Minor repairs and a new stain will be less expensive than replacing several boards and applying a specialized coating. To get an accurate estimate, it's essential to have a professional assessment of your deck's current state. Hometelligent Inc. provides detailed quotes after an on-site evaluation to ensure all factors affecting cost are considered.
